Name: Inventory Next-Prev
Author: chyrop
Description:
This mod lets you configure keys to select the next/previous slots of the inventory toolbar - by default using the MouseX1 and MouseX2, the "extra" mouse side-buttons.

I expect it to work on with other mods, even if they affect the inventory / toolbar, but if you find any incompatibilities, feel free to post a message.

There is also a setting to select the number of slots to cycle, e.g. 3 slots for the mine with weapon/pickaxe/food, or if you use a mod changing your toolbar size. GMCM-compatible, if you have it installed.

Sorry for the lame banner image, don't hesitate to submit a better one!
